[RBND.1.4] **The RT-config binding tuple.** Artifacts that
emerge from a configured live engine (event traces, DAP traces)
carry a second binding describing the runtime pool sizes,
budgets, and policy under which the engine was operating:

```
rt_config_sha256    — SHA-256 of the canonical serialization
                      of the resolved RT configuration the
                      engine ran with (per RBND.4b)
```

The engine's strategy is not part of this binding: it follows from the
resolved settings ([RDSC.16.2.1]), which the dialect binding already
carries.

Compile-time and pre-RT artifacts (DSC, RT profile) do not
carry this binding — a DSC predates engine sizing, and a
profile is the input to RT config, not an output. The full
list of which containers carry which binding is [RBND.2].
